firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Following the host ruling on KneeCoT (institutional/ethics agreement required → not allowed), could the host clarify the status of datasets DERIVED from OAI but re-hosted fully publicly — no registration, no agreement, standard open license?

Concrete example: OAIZIB-CM on Hugging Face (ungated, CC BY-NC 4.0; 507 DESS exams with tissue segmentation masks).

Two specific questions:
1. Does "publicly and freely available" refer to the dataset actually being used (the ungated public re-release), or does the provenance of the source images (OAI, which itself requires a data use agreement) make such derivatives ineligible?
2. If allowed: the winners' obligation releases weights under CC BY-NC 4.0 — we read CC BY-NC pretraining data as compatible with that, is this correct?

This complements the still-open questions in the earlier external-data threads. A written ruling either way would help everyone plan compute fairly. Thanks!
